title: The Living Abroad Academy - Videos
description:
The Living Abroad Academy helps you understand what it takes to take the leap and establish residency in Europe. We cover not only the important aspects you need to consider–visas, housing, healthcare, taxes and more–but also the mindset needed to live full time outside your comfort zone.

Making this kind of move is not for everyone. It may not be achievable due to you work, family, or financial obligations. You also may not have the personality or patience to deal with the day-to-day realities of a particular country. Our goal is to help you find out what country (or countries) will truly work for you.

With The Living Abroad Academy, you'll learn everything you need to know to make an informed and confident decision without having to spend hours, months, or years, researching on your own. Learn more at LivingAbroadAcademy.com
